description: 经典暖调 - 暖棕与橙色点缀，亲切自然、叙事感温和，适合生活 / 品牌 / 经验分享

styles.body: font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #3b2f2f; line-height: 1.86; letter-spacing: 0.25px; padding: 15px 13px; background: #fffdf9;
styles.h1: font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.38; margin: 34px 0 18px; padding-bottom: 10px; color: #5f2d1b; font-weight: 800; border-bottom: 2px solid #d97706;
styles.h2: font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.46; margin: 32px 0 16px; color: #7a3118; font-weight: 750; border-left: 4px solid #d97706; padding: 7px 0 7px 12px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fff3df 0%, #fffdf9 78%);
styles.p: margin: 0 0 17px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.86; color: #3b2f2f; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: margin: 22px 0; padding: 17px 19px; color: #7a3118; background: #fff4e5; border: 1px solid #f6d8b6; border-left: 3px solid #d97706; border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.82;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 10px; margin: 23px auto; display: block; border: 1px solid #f3d3b0; box-shadow: 0 7px 20px rgba(180,83,9,0.10);
styles.code_inline: font-family: Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.92em; background: #fff3e0; color: #7c2d12; padding: 0.1em 0.34em; border-radius: 4px;
styles.code_block: margin: 1em 0; padding: 1em; background: #402217; color: #fdecd6; border-radius: 8px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6;
styles.li_bullet: display: inline-block; min-width: 16px; margin-right: 9px; color: #d97706; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900;
styles.li_number: display: inline-block; min-width: 25px; margin-right: 9px; color: #b45309; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; vertical-align: -1px;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 22px 0; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #f0cfaa; table-layout: fixed; word-break: break-word;
styles.th: border: 1px solid #f0cfaa; padding: 9px 10px; background: #fff0dc; color: #7a3118; text-align: left; font-weight: 700;
styles.td: border: 1px solid #f0cfaa; padding: 9px 10px; color: #4b3631; vertical-align: top; line-height: 1.62;
styles.caption: font-size: 12.5px; color: #7a7f87; text-align: center; margin-top: 9px; line-height: 1.6;
styles.section_divider: text-align: center; color: #d97706; letter-spacing: 10px; font-size: 12px; margin: 36px 0; user-select: none; opacity: 0.65;

highlights.hl_yellow: background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 55%, #ffe29a 55%); color: #5f2d1b; padding: 0 3px; font-weight: 600;

list_style.label: 暖橙圈号
list_style.num_container: display: inline-block; min-width: 25px; margin-right: 9px; color: #b45309; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; vertical-align: -1px;
list_style.bullet_container: display: inline-block; min-width: 16px; margin-right: 9px; color: #d97706; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900;
